instruction: A minimalist studio portrait photograph, captured in a medium close-up shot at eye-level against a solid beige background. The man in the white t-shirt (R1) stands on the left in profile facing left with his head tilted slightly back. The man in the pink t-shirt (R2) stands behind him, leaning his head down to rest his cheek on R1's shoulder while looking directly at the camera with a melancholic expression. R2 wraps his arms around R1, holding R1's shoulder and waist. The lighting is soft and diffused, casting gentle shadows and highlighting the warm, pastel color palette of their clothing against the neutral backdrop.
